one_liner: TranscriptAPI (transcriptapi.com) is a hosted REST API for YouTube transcripts, search, channels and playlists. It uses a self-serve Bearer API key and has free signup. It has a vendor-hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: The REST API uses a Bearer API key in the Authorization header, obtained from the dashboard API Keys page. The hosted MCP server uses OAuth with client credentials from the dashboard. The REST docs describe no OAuth flow.
access_notes: The docs say to sign up free for an account and get a key from the dashboard. The fetched pages do not show the 100 free credits or the $5/month pricing from the draft, because the quote falls in truncated text. Credits are metered per call, and some endpoints are free. The free-tier size is unverified.
blocker_notes: No blocker found. Usage is credit-metered. The docs list about 13 endpoints, which is moderate breadth. The free-credit amount is not confirmed in the fetched text.
